sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact medical reasoning checkpoint and explicit Qwen2.5-32B base lineage; documents thinking_mode on/off/auto and standard target-model loading. Optional EAGLE3 inference separately loads the draft subdirectory. Reopened for the October 27 parameter re-audit: current main remains this revision; card metadata names Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B exactly and the introduction explicitly describes domain-specific fine-tuning.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B target configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen2ForCausalLM: 64 layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 27648, 40 query heads and 8 KV heads, vocabulary 152064, untied embeddings, max_position_embeddings=131072, no expert routing or quantization configuration. Fresh comparison with the named base configuration finds identical parameter-bearing dimensions; differences are token IDs, a null rope_scaling field and the Transformers version, not pruning, expert expansion or added modalities.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B Apache License
sources.evidence: Exact repository LICENSE is Apache License Version 2.0 with inherited Alibaba Cloud copyright; the model-card license declaration agrees.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public and ungated repository at revision 360f684d3cd527a4ef986c54071015eb0e6def58. Structured safetensors metadata reports 32763876352 BF16 parameters. This metadata was independently verified by all target shard headers. Fresh API check on October 27 confirms the same revision and total, and base_model metadata explicitly names Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B; no shard headers were reread in this pass.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B target index and all 14 shard headers
sources.evidence: Range-read all 14 original BF16 safetensors headers at the pinned revision. All 771 tensor names match the index exactly and their shape products sum to 32763876352. Includes untied input/output matrices, dense MLPs, attention weights and biases, and normalization. No scale, zero-point, rotary or other buffer tensors occur.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B chat and tool template
sources.evidence: Serializes tool definitions, structured function names and JSON arguments in tool_call blocks, and tool_response messages. Handles reasoning_content and think delimiters with selectable thinking_mode. Evidence establishes format support, not benchmarked tool reliability.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2 technical blog
sources.evidence: The initial HTML is a client-rendered shell; fetched its referenced JavaScript chunk to read the article. It confirms Qwen2.5-32B lineage and separate EAGLE3/MTP deployment; limitations state that tool invocation has not yet been fully optimized. No explicit publication date was found.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2: Scaling Medical Capability with Large Verifier System
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and extracted with pdftotext. States nominal 32B; section 3.2 specifies Qwen2.5-32B-Base SFT at 32K context; section 5.2 describes a separately trained lightweight draft model verified by the larger target. No separate active-parameter count or accounting convention is disclosed. Reopened the HTML report in this pass: section 3.2 explicitly names Qwen2.5-32B-Base; section 5.2 keeps the lightweight speculative draft separate from the target.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B weight repository history
sources.evidence: Repository creation and weight uploads date to August 10, 2025, with updates August 11; report link was added September 3 and later edits occurred December 24. Commit timestamps do not establish when a repository became public.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B original public-project README commit
sources.evidence: GitHub history dates the initial model README to August 11, 2025. Read the README at this revision; it describes the medical model and links its weights. The timestamp corroborates launch timing but does not independently prove public visibility.

sources.title: Hongxin Electronics announcement about the Baichuan-M2 launch
sources.evidence: Announcement attributed to the compute partner states that Baichuan officially released Baichuan-M2 on August 11. It describes Hongxin subsidiary Suihong Huachuang as supplying compute for this model. Publication is August 18, distinct from the stated launch date.

sources.title: Contemporaneous Baichuan-M2 release coverage
sources.publisher: Shanghai Securities News / China Securities Network, syndicated by Sina
sources.evidence: August 11, 2025 article explicitly reports Baichuan releasing Baichuan-M2 that day. Used only for public launch chronology, not technical specifications.

sources.title: Baichuan official model catalog
sources.evidence: Indexed primary homepage lists exact Baichuan-M2 with nominal 32B, reasoning, open commercial use, and advertised 32K context. Direct HTML retrieval is client-rendered; this evidence is indexed page content, not an endpoint test.

sources.title: Baichuan-M3 technical report: exact M2 comparison
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and extracted. Table 2 explicitly includes Baichuan-M2-32B, but compares HealthBench and hallucination rates rather than reporting total or active parameters. M3 architecture and capabilities were not transferred to M2. Reopened the later HTML comparison in this pass; Table 2 still supplies no activated-parameter column for M2.

sources.title: Baichuan-M4 technical report
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and extracted; reference 2 cites Baichuan-M2. No exact M2 active-parameter count was found. New M4 agent or modality capabilities were not transferred to M2. Reopened the later HTML report in this pass; it cites M2 without an M2 parameter disclosure.

sources.title: Developer-shipped Qwen2 target implementation for speculative serving
sources.evidence: Despite its draft folder location, this file defines the target Qwen2ForCausalLM replacement used by the README instructions. Every decoder layer performs attention followed by a dense gated MLP. It defines input embedding and untied LM head modules, and no sparse expert router.

sources.title: Optional EAGLE3 draft configuration
sources.evidence: Separately loaded LlamaForCausalLMEagle3 draft, with one layer, hidden size 5120 and draft vocabulary 32000. It is not part of the target-model safetensors index.

sources.title: Optional EAGLE3 draft checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Range-read only the first 64KiB; parsed ZIP-local data.pkl opcodes with inert GLOBAL handling, without importing or executing pickle content. The 16 BF16 weight/bias tensors contain 766798848 learned parameters. Excluded two vocabulary-mapping buffers: d2t int64[32000] and t2d bool[152064]. This separate optional model is not added to the target count.

sources.title: Linked Chinese launch announcement
sources.evidence: The linked launch article returned an access interstitial rather than article text; author and publication time could not be verified from this endpoint.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 4: Qwen2.5-32B-Base activated parameters
sources.evidence: Table 4 identifies Qwen2.5-32B Base as dense and explicitly lists 32B in both Total Params and Activated Params rows. This is a published nominal active count for the exact named base, supporting a lineage inference for Baichuan-M2; it is not a direct Baichuan-M2 active-count attestation or an exact tensor accounting rule.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-32B named base configuration
sources.evidence: Current base revision 1818d35814b8319459f4bd55ed1ac8709630f003. Compared with Baichuan-M2 target: same Qwen2ForCausalLM architecture, 64 layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 27648, 40 attention heads, 8 KV heads, vocabulary 152064 and untied embeddings. No parameter-bearing dimension changes, sparse experts or modality components appear. Token IDs and Transformers version differ; target additionally records rope_scaling=null.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-32B repository metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh API check identifies the pinned base revision and reports 32763876352 BF16 parameters, equal to the current Baichuan-M2 target metadata and preserved earlier target tensor count. This corroborates unchanged model size without downloading weights.

sources.title: Baichuan-M2-32B current official project README
sources.evidence: Current official README repeats the Qwen2.5-32B base relationship and describes medical-domain mid-training and reinforcement learning. It provides no separate activated-parameter number and does not describe pruning, expert expansion or added target modalities.

name.note: Display normalization of the exact Baichuan-M2-32B checkpoint name.

developer.note: Catalog normalization of Baichuan AI, identified by its official model card and repository.

family.note: Catalog family name follows the developer-branded Baichuan series; Qwen2.5 is the explicit base lineage, not the product-family label.

release_date.note: Public launch date supported by contemporary reporting and the compute partner announcement; GitHub history corroborates it. August 10 is repository creation/upload, not proven public launch; September 2 is the paper date. The baseline August 13 was not substantiated. Date evidence includes syndicated material, so the entire record is not promoted to primary source status.

open_weights.note: All 14 target shards were publicly range-readable without authentication, and the exact repository supplies a license.

license.note: Current exact-checkpoint LICENSE and card both state Apache 2.0; this is not inferred from the base model alone.

parameters_b.note: Complete target-model learned parameter count from the prior audit of all 771 tensor shapes across 14 BF16 shards, freshly corroborated by unchanged current repository metadata. Includes both untied embedding matrices, attention biases and normalization. The developer label 32B is nominal. Separate optional draft model is excluded from this scalar; no weight shards were downloaded or recounted in this pass.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal active count inferred from explicit Qwen2.5-32B-Base fine-tuning lineage. The base developer explicitly reports 32B activated parameters in Qwen3 Table 4; the target and named base have identical parameter-bearing configuration dimensions and current metadata totals, with no structural change defeating this inference. This is not an exact per-token tensor count or a direct Baichuan-M2 active-count disclosure. The separately loaded optional EAGLE3 draft is excluded.

architecture.note: Qwen2 decoder-only dense Transformer, 64 attention-plus-gated-MLP layers with grouped-query attention. Exact config, complete shapes and developer target implementation establish the architecture; no MoE routing is present.

context_window.note: Exact target configuration max_position_embeddings. This is a configured positional limit, not verified long-context quality or API capacity. The developer homepage advertises 32K and the report describes 32K SFT; retain that discrepancy explicitly instead of treating 131072 as the advertised/training context.

modalities.note: Exact checkpoint contains text embeddings, decoder and language head; the card uses text prompts and generated tokens. No native image/audio/video encoder or output component exists in the inspected target inventory.

reasoning.note: Exact release documents selectable on/off/auto thinking and a separate parsed thinking-content channel; the template implements think delimiters. This is dedicated mode support, not an inference from generic chain-of-thought training.

tool_call.note: Exact tokenizer template accepts tool schemas and serializes structured function calls and tool responses. This establishes format support; the developer explicitly cautions that tool invocation is not fully optimized, and no reliability claim is made.

description.value: Open-weight medical language model based on Qwen2.5-32B, with dense architecture and selectable thinking modes.

patch.notes: Target checkpoint count is 32.763876352B learned parameters; nominal developer label is 32B. Optional EAGLE3 draft is separate (0.766798848B learned parameters, excluding vocabulary mapping buffers) and is not included. Nominal active count is 32B, inferred from the explicit Qwen2.5-32B base lineage and its developer-published activated count; parameter-bearing dimensions are unchanged. This is not an exact per-token count. Config permits 131072 positions, while the official homepage advertises 32K and the report describes 32K SFT. Tool-call serialization is present but the developer says tool invocation is not fully optimized. Public launch is August 11, 2025, supported by contemporary news and a syndicated compute-partner announcement rather than repository modification dates.

parameter_audit.method: Sum product(shape) for each unique target tensor, verify exact equality of names with the target index, and reconcile components. No byte-to-parameter conversion and no base-model count inheritance.

research_scope: Read exact pinned card/config/license/template/index, all target shard headers, target implementation and optional draft metadata; downloaded/extracted M2, M3 and M4 full PDFs and inspected relevant sections and exact M2 comparisons. Read developer blog via its referenced static chunk and indexed official model catalog. Targeted exact-name searches for active/activated parameters found no later primary disclosure. Launch chronology uses contemporaneous reporting and an attributed compute-partner announcement because linked WeChat article content was inaccessible. October 27 parameter-only re-audit reopened the current official Hugging Face card/config/metadata, current GitHub README, M2 sections 3.2 and 5.2, and later M3/M4 HTML reports. Compared the target with the exact named Qwen2.5-32B base config and metadata, and checked the base developer's Qwen3 Table 4. Fresh exact-model active/activated searches and first-party Baichuan/arXiv searches found no later direct M2 active disclosure; this does not negate the supported nominal lineage inference. Preserved the prior complete target count and component inventory without repeating tensor reads.
summary: Parameter re-audit preserves the complete target count 32.763876352B and component breakdown, and resolves nominal active parameters to 32B by explicit Qwen2.5-32B-Base lineage plus Qwen's activated-parameter table and matching parameter-bearing configurations. No later direct M2 active disclosure or exact per-token count was found. Prior dense architecture, tool-call support, August 11 public launch and qualified 131072 positional limit remain unchanged. The separately loaded optional draft remains excluded.
